name: Kosaka-san.
source: After an unpleasant incident, the unnamed high-school student protagonist finds himself unable to make friends with most of his classmates. To escape the bustle of lunch time, he goes to the school rooftop. However, one day he finds there a girl who tells him a meteorite is about to hit Earth and wipe humanity, and that she wants to commit suicide before that happens.
translation: 一次不愉快事件后，未命名高中生主人公无法与大多数同学交朋友。为了逃避午餐时间的喧闹，他来到学校屋顶。然而，某天他在那里发现一名女孩。女孩告诉他，一颗陨石即将撞击地球、消灭人类，而她想在那之前自杀。
